post.summary: Approve and pin the exact final video release
post.description: CEO session with CSRF and verified isolation only. The confirmation must match the current final-cut artifact, MP4 hash, approved manifest, timeline plan and source, audio cue and bytes, Rian decision, and Quinn QA evidence and decision. Creates an immutable release row; it never impersonates an agent.

400.description: Exact release confirmation is required.

409.description: Current decision, media bytes, or release snapshot changed.

503.description: Isolation or storage is unavailable.

400.description: Attempt identifier required.
